units.title: Preliminary
units.topics: Important definitions under Income Tax Act, Basis of charge, Scope of total income, Incomes which do not form part of total income, Heads of income.

units.title: Income from Salary
units.topics: Provisions relating to income under the head Salary, Deductions from salary, Basic numerical problems or/and computation of income under the head Salaries.

units.title: Income from House Property
units.topics: Provisions relating to income under the head Income from House Property, Annual value determination, Deductions from house property, Basic numerical problems on computation of income from house property.

units.title: Profits and Gains of Business or Profession
units.topics: Provisions relating to income under the head Profits and Gains of Business or Profession, Allowable and disallowable deductions, Basic numerical problems on computation of income from business or profession.

units.title: Capital Gains
units.topics: Provisions relating to Income from Capital Gains, Short-term and long-term capital gains, Computation of capital gains, Exemptions under sections 54, 54B, 54EC, 54F, Basic numerical problems.

units.title: Income from Other Sources
units.topics: Provisions relating to Income from Other Sources, Specific and general incomes chargeable under this head, Deductions allowed, Basic numerical problems on computation of income from other sources.

units.title: Income Tax Authorities, Jurisdiction and Functions
units.topics: Income tax authorities, Appointment and control, Jurisdiction of income tax authorities, Exercise of jurisdiction, Competency of authority, Powers and functions of authorities.

units.title: Powers
units.topics: Discovery, production of evidence, Search and seizure, Power of requisition, Books of accounts, Inquiries, Survey, Power to inspect registers of companies, Faceless collection of information.

units.title: Return of Income
units.topics: Allotment of Permanent Account Number (PAN), Filing of return of income, Tax Return Preparers Scheme, Return by whom to be signed, Defective return, Self-assessment, Assessment procedures: Summary assessment, Scrutiny assessment, Best judgment assessment, Faceless assessment.

units.title: Clubbing of Income and Aggregate of Income
units.topics: Income of other persons included in assessee's total income, Clubbing of income of spouse, minor child, son's wife, Cross transfers, Aggregate of income, Cash credits, Unexplained investments, Unexplained money, Amount of investments not fully disclosed.

units.title: Set Off, Carry Forward and Set Off of Losses
units.topics: Set off of loss from one source against income from another source under same head, Set off of loss from one head against income from another head, Carry forward and set off of loss from house property, business loss, speculation loss, capital loss, loss from activity of owning and maintaining race horses.

units.title: Deductions to be made in computing Total Income
units.topics: Deductions in respect of certain payments: Section 80C, 80CCC, 80CCD, 80D, 80DD, 80DDB, 80E, 80G, 80GG, Deductions in respect of certain incomes: 80TTA, 80TTB, 80U, Computation of total income and tax liability of individuals.

units.title: Collection and Advance Payment of Tax
units.topics: Deduction of tax at source (TDS): Salaries, interest, contract payments, professional fees, Collection of tax at source (TCS), Advance payment of tax: Liability, installments, due dates, computation, Interest payable under sections 234A, 234B, 234C, Refunds.

notes: Revised syllabus of Advanced Accounting & Taxation major courses for M.Com. Sem-I and Sem-II.
